question: Which of the 33 modules show group differences in module eigengene across ctrl/bp_nolith/bp_lith after composition adjustment, extending the darkturquoise analysis (007) to all modules?
rationale: Analyses 007-008 showed darkturquoise survives composition adjustment when comparing controls vs bp_lith. We don't know if this is unique to darkturquoise or common across modules. This analysis tests all 33 modules with the same model used in 007.
samples: all 460 with complete ILR data (ctrl=234, bp_nolith=74, bp_lith=152)
model: ME ~ group + b1 + b2 + b3 + b4 (additive, same as analysis 007)
pre_specified_tests: ANOVA F-test for group across all 33 modules (BH correction)
For each module: pairwise t-tests control vs lith and nolith vs lith (Bonferroni n=3 within module)
correction: BH across 33 modules for group ANOVA; Bonferroni n=3 within each module for pairwise
